note: The source gives no separate genus diagnosis, only one step of the soldier key and a genus remark; only the characters that can be verified there are given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Monotypic, containing only Hesperotermes infrequens. Soldier with a reduced frontal tubercle and a reddish brown head capsule; in the soldier key to the Termes complex, a reduced frontal tubercle leads directly to this genus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Frontal tubercle reduced (Fig. 5a); head capsule reddish brown; otherwise similar to the Termes complex; no separate genus diagnosis is given in the source.
